message:
You know that one friend who always panics at the slightest hint of trouble? We all have one! Last week, she called me in a tizzy because she heard a weather alert for our area. 

Instead of joining her in the frenzy, we took a moment to breathe and talk through what we could do. We made a quick checklist of things to gather, like our go-bags and important documents, just in case. 

It was a great reminder that preparedness doesn't have to be stressful; it can be a simple plan we make together. Plus, it felt nice to turn her worry into a little bit of action. Have you checked in with your own go-bag lately? 🌱
